Unique Research · Company / Funding · June 15, 2022

On Jun 10, 2022, Taiwan-based SCRM GoSky AI (founded 2018) closed a seed led by 500 Global, with ThunderCore co-founder Chris Wang and Xchange Taiwan — for product innovation and intl expansion. Convert FB/IG followers to members in ~3 seconds without a native app; no-code social membership live in <1 hour. Focus F&B, sports, new media; first-party data MarTech from social interaction → lifetime member.

— END —
